data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Piraa', which means 'Light' or 'Radiant'. This name is often given to babies born during the night or under the light of the moon. The name Piraya carries the meaning “Light, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Piraya usually hope their child will grow to embody light, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
